# Glossary {#sec-apph}

Every acronym, YAML key and symbol the chapters use, with the meaning its first-use note gives and the section that
defines it. The list is generated from `tools/reader-glossary.json`, the book's one concept registry; a symbol is
defined by its group of the notation index (@sec-appa), an acronym by the section that writes out its expansion, and a
key by the reference-table row that names it. Where no section defines a concept, the entry says "not defined here"
and links the first section that uses it.
